text:
A wire carrying a current is placed in a magnetic field. The wire experiences a force due to the
field.
Which action does not change the direction of the force?
A
increasing the current and reversing the field direction
B
increasing the current, keeping the field direction constant
C
reversing the current and increasing the field strength
D
reversing the current, keeping the field direction constant

options.label: A
options.text: increasing the current and reversing the field direction

options.label: B
options.text: increasing the current, keeping the field direction constant

options.label: C
options.text: reversing the current and increasing the field strength

options.label: D
options.text: reversing the current, keeping the field direction constant
